customManagers.description: Read the dependency blocks of each template's package.json.jinja. Renovate's npm manager parses only files whose names end in json, so until 2026-11-03 nothing updated these and new projects started a major behind the fleet. tests.sh checks this extracts every dependency listed.
And the pnpm version the template pins in packageManager.

packageRules.description: A template change reaches a new project only with a platform release, so template updates are fix(templates), which cuts one; as chore(deps) they would merge and never ship. Monthly, because every release ends in a template-sync PR in each fleet repo.
schedule: before 06:00 on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Keep the template's non-major updates out of the weekly batch, so that batch stays a chore that cuts no release. They still merge themselves once green, with selftest's render jobs as the check.

Lock file maintenance lists the template's pnpm-workspace.yaml among its package files, so the template rules above would make it a weekly fix that cuts a release. Keep it the chore it was, on the preset's Monday schedule.
